title: Ukraine updates: Kyiv targeted by missile strikes, bridges hit
summary: Ukraine's capital has been struck by Russian missiles with at least 3 deaths reported. The latest strikes come after Vladimir Putin warned of a "painful" response following the Kerch bridge strikes.…

image.caption: Mayor Vitali Klitschko said at least three people have been killed and 13 others injuredImage: Gleb Garanich/REUTERS

blocks.text: Ukraine's capital has been struck by Russian missiles with at least 3 deaths reported. The latest strikes come after Vladimir Putin warned of a "painful" response following the Kerch bridge strikes. Follow DW.

blocks.caption: Mayor Vitali Klitschko said at least three people have been killed and 13 others injuredImage: Gleb Garanich/REUTERS

items: Kyiv's mayor says 3 killed after Russian missile attacks
Three bridges in the capital reported to have been damaged
Russian media reporting visit by EU representatives to Russia 'under consideration'
